name: search_product
description: Search the catalogue for products by name (Arabic, English, or brand) or active ingredient. Use this before any stock/order/hold action to resolve what the customer means. Returns candidate products; if more than one plausibly matches, do NOT guess — ask the customer or, if still unclear, escalate.

query.description: Customer's term for the product: Arabic name, English name, brand, or ingredient. e.g. 'بنادول', 'panadol', 'paracetamol'.

branch_id.description: Optional. Restrict results to products stocked at this branch.

returns.description: candidates: list of {product_id, name_ar, name_en, brand, is_restricted, requires_prescription}. May be empty.
